# <type>(<scope>): <subject>
#
# <body>
#
# <footer>

# Type should be one of the following:
# * feat: A new feature
# * fix: A bug fix
# * update: General update
# * update-design: Design/UI update
# * refactor: Code refactoring
# * docs: Documentation update
# * style: Code style changes
# * test: Adding or updating tests
# * chore: Maintenance tasks
# * ci: CI/CD changes
# * perf: Performance improvements
# * build: Build system changes
# * revert: Reverting previous changes
#
# Scope is optional and should be the area of the codebase affected
# Subject should be a brief description of the change
# Body should provide more detailed explanation if needed
# Footer should contain any breaking changes or issue references
#
# Example:
# feat(chatbot): add auto-close functionality after account creation
#
# - Added 3-second countdown timer
# - Implemented cancel auto-close option
# - Updated UI to show countdown in header
#
# Closes #123
